CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cantinarr is a self-hosted request and media-management front end for Radarr, Sonarr, and Chaptarr. Your household browses movies, TV, and books and taps request; you keep approvals, per-user access, and quality control.
This repository holds its Unraid Community Applications template. The application itself lives at https://github.com/windoze95/cantinarr and the template is updated from there whenever a port, volume, or environment variable changes.
Support: open an issue at https://github.com/windoze95/cantinarr/issues -- feature requests go to https://cantinarr.com/roadmap/ , no account needed.
